sentences.en: The faithful talking with tongues were taken by bystanders for drunken men, but intoxicated men do not talk in languages of which they are normally ignorant.2 Paul on the whole discouraged glossolaly.

sentences.en: The union proved childless and unhappy, and in 1780 the countess fled for refuge from her husband's drunken violence to a convent in Florence, where Charles had been residing since 1 774.

sentences.en: In his private life Ranjit Singh was selfish, avaricious, drunken and immoral, but he had a genius for command and was the only man the Sikhs ever produced strong enough to bind them together.

sentences.en: Having taken the drunken Silenus back to his youthful charge Dionysus, he was rewarded by the god with the power of transforming everything he touched into gold.

sentences.en: The medieval Jews also held that there is a cardiac demon in wine which takes possession of drunken men; and the Mahommedan prohibition of wine-drinking is based on a similar superstition.

sentences.en: Moreover, even after discounting the bias of his enemies, there is evidence to prove that his championship of the Church was not the outcome of his zeal for Christianity; for he was notoriously drunken, unchaste, avaricious and almost insanely ambitious.
sentences.vi: Hơn nữa, ngay cả sau khi hạ thấp thành kiến của kẻ thù của mình, có bằng chứng để chứng minh rằng chức vô địch của ông đối với Giáo hội không phải là kết quả của lòng nhiệt thành đối với Cơ đốc giáo của ông; vì anh ta khét tiếng là say rượu, bất cần, hám lợi và gần như tham vọng điên cuồng.

sentences.en: In later times they are often represented drawing the car of Dionysus, or bound and ridden by Eros, in allusion to their drunken and amorous habits.

sentences.en: In Steve's third floor room our drunken antics begin with an attempt to throw the TV out of the window.
